composition_contract.budget: Authored per-execute budget100000, checked by pinned AMX model; native wrapper resource caps remain separately tested refusals.
composition_contract.equality: Two separately constructed, identically configured replay replicas compare complete owned snapshots. These are equal local roles, not opposite transport endpoints.
composition_contract.failure_policy: First callback/VM/budget exception latches its enclosing host operation, retains partial model state, and rejects later mutating submissions. VM nonzero errors latch execute. This wrapper policy is authored.
composition_contract.messages: Explicit authored message7 sets an item modifier; message failure preserves modifier and latches the host. No original game-message semantic claim.
composition_contract.negative_anchor: hash_collision preserves the network sync record while changing converted combat armor. Full item/VM/network/RNG/events state is serialized, not the network hash alone.
composition_contract.numeric_calls: Script callbacks call pinned items modifiers/statistics, explicit field-copy combat record adapter, pinned combat statistics and base_roll/Seed.draw, and pinned core from_int/add. Items retain their fixed Ps2 arithmetic; core/combat/netwire use the selected configuration.
composition_contract.rng_domains: Combat seed/draw history is separate from network_seed (zero here). Drawing never implicitly publishes combat state to the wire hash.
composition_contract.task_order: Ready-frame task executes authored AMX public, then explicitly increments supplied sim_frame and sync_acc by 1 and 17. This is a fixture policy, not a recovered engine scheduler.

scope: Independent authored composition of pinned RTA module models; no original game loop, native handlers, movement, HP updates, UDP transport, console or Norrath parity claim.
